data.name: Hordebreaker
data.description: When you hit an evil humanoid with an attack of opportunity, you deal an additional 1d6 points of damage. When using holy reach, you may make %1 additional attacks of opportunity per round. This increase stacks with similar increases from other sources such as Combat Reflexes.|HordebreakerAttacks
